about: Holiday Nights of Lights is a free drive-through holiday light display at Frances Park in Lansing.
It runs on three weekends in December 2026: December 4 to 6, 11 to 13 and 18 to 20, from 6 to 9 PM each night.
Families drive through the lit park, so it works for little ones in pajamas and for grandparents who prefer to stay warm in the car.
The City of Lansing runs the display, and it costs nothing to attend.
